OK-GEMMA.

proper file management is essential for maintaining data integrity and preventing loss. always create regular backups of your important documents on separate drives or cloud storage. organize folders using a logical naming convention so you can find information quickly. avoid overwriting existing files by using version control or saving copies with unique timestamps. always double check the file extension before saving changes. deleting files should be done with caution. being mindful of file organization ensures efficiency and security.
